Create a slide titled “April Attendance” with one bullet per person in the format “Name: xxx times”. Save it as April Attendance.pptx and tell Chen Xinyi where it was saved.

pm-present-engineer-group-members.summary: Prepare one slide per employee showing the engineering role and everyone in that role, then notify Chen Xinyi.

Create one presentation slide per employee; each slide should state the role and the names of all employees who hold that role. Save the deck as engineers.pptx and inform Chen Xinyi, who is coordinating the career fair.

pm-projects-analytics.description: Review all project metrics in Plane Analytics and report: Open Tasks, Backlog Tasks, Unstarted Tasks, Started Tasks, Unassigned Issues, and total Pending Issues. Share the summary using these labels and values with the team in #kudos.
